definition: Which session a moment falls in, by the market's own calendar and clock.
boundaries: The calendars are data (C-03's cme-*@1, nyse@1, the index CFD calendars and crypto-24x7@1), named by the instrument record's calendar_ref; trading-session@1 is FX's liquidity waves. Name the clock and its daylight-saving rule.
recognition: The same hour is London's open on FX and pre-market on stocks.

class_meanings.fx: Liquidity waves (Asia, London, New York) in a 24/5 market; the day turns at 17:00 New York or the broker's server time.
class_meanings.metal: The COMEX week, 18:00 to 17:00 New York, with London's auctions inside it.
class_meanings.index_cfd: The broker's hours around the index's cash session in the index's own clock.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: The underlying future's exchange hours, with its daily break.
class_meanings.future: Exchange hours with a daily break (16:00 to 17:00 Chicago on Globex).
class_meanings.perp: No venue hours: 24/7, bars turn at 00:00 UTC.
class_meanings.spot_crypto: No venue hours: 24/7, bars turn at 00:00 UTC.
class_meanings.stock: Open and close auctions, with pre-market and after-hours sessions.

sources.quote: Crypto: no venue hours, 00:00 UTC bar boundary
